changes.description: Complete eye/cartouche, full lower curled ornament and all three gray captions, including the detached APOCALYPSE caption. The neighboring camp retains all of its own artwork; its foreign ornament is reassigned.
Complete Baal/Logos conversation, including the yellow narration and all speech.
Complete cave silhouette dialogue with all four speech bodies.
Complete scarab-and-pointing-hand scene; the full fist, red clothing and speech body remain.
Complete large Logos portrait/dialogue with all connected speech bodies.
Complete horizontal falling-at-Osiris scene and all three yellow narration boxes. The small adjoining halo/head fragment adds zero.

Complete narrow Nur portrait (NUR balloon and fallen figure). The adjoining standing goddess loses her upper head/halo and remains incomplete: zero additional credit. This is one complete original inside a partly incomplete group.
Complete lower-right narrow Nur face, including the hair, eyes, mouth and chin.
Complete large transformation scene with the Pharaoh above and smiling En below. The neighboring inset and lower Nur scene keep their own crops.

cropReview.countingRule: Each unique complete original once. Partial originals, foreign fragments, duplicates, cover fragments and the incomplete goddess add zero; group usability remains separate.
